verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a desktop and mobile note app, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any setting to disable them. Local Markdown storage, the no-sign-up free tier, and Sync's end-to-end encryption are adjacent privacy features and do not amount to a documented opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
